summary.en: Four L-shaped corners fly in as one frame, shrink past the target, bite onto it with a click, and a small label pops above.
summary.zh: 四个 L 形角标组成的取景框从画外冲进来，收缩过头再回弹，“咔”地咬住目标，上方弹出一枚小标签。

fits: Pointing at one region while the picture keeps running: the panel, the number, the button the next line is about.
notFor: More than two locks a film, or twice on the same target (it reads as a military template); a frozen frame to annotate (use time-freeze).

intent.en: "This one" without stopping the picture: a targeting frame catches one region in motion with a felt click, so the eye goes straight there.
intent.zh: 不停画面就说“看这个”：取景框在运动中咔地咬住一块区域，视线立刻被带过去。

content.en: The target's rect on the running scene and an optional label (≤ 16 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters); a stopping list can fire it on its stop frame.
content.zh: 目标在画面里的位置，加一枚可选标签（≤ 16 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字）；滚动急停的列表可在停住那帧触发。

fits.zh: 画面照常走时点名一块区域：下一句要讲的面板、数字或按钮。

notFor.zh: 一支片锁两次以上，或同一目标锁两次（像军事模板）；冻结画面再标注（用 time-freeze）。

pairs.note: the brackets that frame a scanned document

en: At most twice a film, on different targets; repeated it reads as a military template.
Give the bite a mechanical click; a game UI sound cheapens it.
Stopping-list variant: the corners must fly on the very frame the list stops, or it reads as two moves.
zh: 一支片最多两次，目标不同；连用像军事模板。
咬合帧配一声机械咔嗒；游戏界面音会显廉价。
急停列表版：角标必须在列表停住的同一帧起飞，错开就成了两个动作。

upstream.use: 任何"看这里"的目标点名（替代箭头圈红，画面不冻结）

upstream.summary: 滚动三段：sin-in 加速→cubic-out 猛减速冲过头 +30px→回弹落定；blur=v×0.12 封顶 24px；角标从 ±620/±320 画外 Easing.back(2.4) 飞入咬合，高亮 6f 内完成、标签 back(2.6) 弹出
upstream.use: changelog/发布史/长列表段落："一直在发货，今天这条最大"；要给停点更强打击感用 B
